rationale: Price is at 87.7% of today's range after a large gap-down open, now recovering toward the 9-EMA ($429.99) and today's high ($432.75), suggesting upward momentum — but the last four 1-minute candles show stalling and slight pullback just below the 9-EMA, indicating resistance at that level. With price compressed between the 9-EMA overhead and VWAP below, the risk/reward for either direction is unclear, and the spread (17.5 bps) adds friction that erodes a short-term edge.
